Section 1 thereof is hereby amended, so as to read as follows:
"Sec 1. Except that portion of the territory consisting the former municipality of Isabela, beginning at point
marked "1" being S41_ 00'E, 4,000 meters to point 2; thence N48_ 30'E, 4,550 meters to point 3; thence from
kilometer 4.60 in crooked line along Tabiawan river to point 4; thence along the shoreline of Isabela Channel
to the point of the beginning, with an area of 300 hectares more or less, comprising the barangays of Campong
Baro, Binuangan, Tabiawan, Busay, Lanote, San Rafael, Menzi, Kumalarang, and Kabong Bata (Reference
used in the preparation of the technical description the map of Basilan City showing road system prepared by
the Department of Public Highways, bearing a scale of 1:120,000), which shall be known as the City of
Basilan, the territory embracing the whole island of Basilan and adjacent islands, which is hereby divided into
municipalities of:
a) Maluso, with territorial area beginning at the point marked "1" beingN11_ 00'E (mouth of Cabcaban river),
14,000 meters to point 2; thence N88 0 - 00'W, 3,00- meters to point 3; thence N88 0 - 00'W, 7,000 meters to
point 4; thence along the coastline to point of the beginning, including Cancuman, Sicagot, Langan, Tamuk,
Takela, Goreno, Tensolan, Pandak and Dalauan islands, with seat of government at Barangay Maluso;
b) Lamitan, with territorial area beginning from point marked "1" being the mouth of Balagtasan river along
the course of the river to Balagtasan bridge to point 2; thence S15_ 00'E, 13,600 meters to point 3; thence
S88_ 00'E, 8,700 meters to point 4; thence N31_ 00'E, 2,500 meters to point 5; thence S69_ 00'5, 7,000
meters to point 6; thence N23_ 00'W, 11,600 meters to point 7; thence N25_ 00'E, 900 meters to point 8;
thence along the coastline to point of the beginning, with seat of government at Barangay Lamitan;
c) Isabela, which is comprised of the remaining barrios and sitios of the former municipality of Isabela, with
seat of government at Barangay Begang;
d) Lantawan, with territorial area beginning at a point marked "1" being S5_ 30'E, 3,600 meters fronting

Balatanay island to point 2; thence S21_ 00'E, 2,900 meters to point 3; thence due south, 4,800 meters to
point 4; thence N88_ 00'W; 7,000 meters to point 5; thence along coastline to point of the beginning,
including Kaluitan and Pangasa-an islands, with seat of government at Barangay Tairan;
e) Sumipsip, with territorial area beginning at a point marked "1" being N11_ 00'E, 14,000 meters to point 2;
thence S88_ 00'E, 11,200 meters to point 3; thence S25_ 00'E, 8,000 meters to point 4; thence along the
coastline of Camalig river to point 5; thence along the coastline to the point of the beginning, with seat of
government at Barangay Mangal;
f) Tipo-Tipo, with territorial area beginning at a point marked "1" being the mouth of Camalig river to point 2;
thence N25_ 00'W, 8,00 meters to point 3; thence S88_ 00'E, 8,700 meters to point 4; thence N31_ 00'E,
2,500 meters to point 5; thence S69_ 00'E, 7,000 meters to point 6; thence along the coastline to point of the
beginning, including Kaulungan island, with seat of government at Barangay Tipo-Tipo;
g) Tuburan, with territorial area beginning from the point marked "1" being N23_ 00'W, 11,600 meters to
point 2; thence N25_ 00'E, 900 meters to point 3; thence along the coastliner to the point of the beginning,
including Coco, Langil and Sibago islands, with seat of government at Barangay Tuburan;
h) Tapiantana, with territorial area comprised of the islands of Bubuan, Saluping, Timbunga, Lanawan and
Tapantiana, with seat of government at Barangay Tapantiana;
i) Malamawi, with territorial area comprised by the islands of Malamawi, Lampinigan, Manulug and
Insabdahon, with seat of government at Barangay Carbon; and
j) Pilas, with territorial area comprised of the islands of Balukbaluk, Mataja, Tagutu, Pilas, Mananggal, Pasig,
Pasilan, Mamanak, Orell, Palamigan, Siringo, Saloro and Sangbay, with seat of government at Barangay Pilas.

Section 2 thereof is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"Sec. 2. The capital of the Province of Basilan shall be the Municipality of Isabela and its seat of government
shall be at Barangay Begang."

Section 3 thereof is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"Sec. 3. Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law now or hereafter applicable to regular provinces
and municipalities shall be applicable to the Province of Basilan and to the municipalities herein created,
respectively."

Section 4 thereof is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"Sec. 4. The present elective officials of the Province of Zamboanga del Sur shall perform their duties as such
officials in the newly created Province of Basilan until the officials of the latter shall have been duly
appointed by the President. The officials of the newly created municipalities shall likewise be appointed by
the President. Such officials thus appointed shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in
the election for provincial and municipal officials following the issuance of this Decree and shall have
qualified unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Other appointive officials and employees as
may be necessary to organize or to complete the government personnel of the provinces and municipalities
herein created shall be appointed as provided for by law."

All laws or parts of law or any executive order, rule and regulation inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon approval.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
